notes.title: Release in Early Access
notes.content:
This game will be released in early access, as it is taking a long time to develop
What can be done in the early access version, will be described later in the early access description.
Sorry for the time it takes.

notes.title: Postponement of Release & Demo Update
notes.content:
I was planning to sell this game in this year, but unfortunately, I could not do it in time, so I will postpone it until next year
We apologize for the inconvenience

The trial version has been updated. There is no new content, but the system of grabbing things, the movements of the insects, the appearance of the partner (only the tracksuit), etc. have been changed

notes.title: Live streaming - Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
I am participating in the Steam Next Fest because I could not complete the game even one year after the trial version was released
And there will be a live streaming of the trial version of this game again
I will mainly introduce the elements added from the last time
The developer are not good at English, so it may take some time to reply

notes.title: Steam Game Festival Autumn Edition
notes.content:
A short trial version of this game will be on display at the Game Festival.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404330/VR/

It is a game to relax and live a quiet life with your partner in VR space. You can also play it on your PC monitor as a normal game
In the trial version, you can catch insects and make a pumpkin pie


VR performance test was performed on Oculus. If you find any problem please let me know
